misconceptions.description: Student writes recursive function without a proper base case, causing infinite recursion
observable_patterns: Function recurses without any termination condition
Base case exists but is wrong (e.g., if n == 0 when n can go negative)
misconceptions.invariant: Every recursive function must have at least one base case that returns without recursing. Every recursive call must make progress toward the base case.

transfer_templates.target_reasoning: 3*factorial(2) → 2*factorial(1) → 1*factorial(0) → 0*factorial(-1) → ... infinite. Fix: if n == 0: return 1 (base case).
